NAME: Jay
LINE: Forget the rulebook for five minutes, okay? We take the shortcut through the rooftops, beat them to the finish line and then grab tacos after... Deal?"

NAME: Andy
LINE: The rooftops? Jay, I'm wearing flip-flops. That's cat territory!

NAME: Jay
LINE: Then you'll be the fastest guy in flip-flops to ever conquer cat territory!

NAME: Florence
LINE: Ahem. Rule fourteen of the Humans-versus-Cats Turf Derby: humans stick to the streets, cats get the alleys, and nobody touches the rooftops!

NAME: Andy
LINE: ...Why is a cat the referee for a human-versus-cat race?

NAME: Florence
LINE: Because I am the only citizen in this city who actually reads the rulebook.

NAME: Marcy
LINE: And I'm the only cat who shreds it! Mrrrow~ The rooftops belong to us, two-legs! Catch you at the finish!

NAME: Jay
LINE: Hey! Those roofs are neutral territory, Marcy—you're cheating too!

NAME: Marcy
LINE: All's fair in a turf war! Whoever wins gets the shortcuts AND the free tacos. Bye-bye!

NAME: Andy
LINE: Oh, it is ON. Flip-flops or not, nobody takes our shortcuts—or my tacos.

NAME: Jay
LINE: That's the spirit! To the rooftops—go, go, go!

NAME: Florence
LINE: Wait! Rule fifteen! Rule sixteen! ...Nobody ever listens to rule sixteen.

NAME: Andy
LINE: I lost a flip-flop. I literally lost a flip-flop on the third roof, Jay.

NAME: Jay
LINE: Mourn it later—the finish banner is right below us. Jump!

NAME: Marcy
LINE: What?! How did two clumsy humans land here ahead of me?!

NAME: Jay
LINE: Our rooftops now, furball. Never underestimate a guy running on pure taco motivation.

NAME: Florence
LINE: I declare a tie. Also, both species are disqualified for violating rooftop neutrality.

NAME: Andy
LINE: Disqualified... AND the taco truck just rolled up its window.

NAME: Marcy
LINE: Don't cry, beach boy. I swiped a taco before they closed. Well... mostly just the cheese.

NAME: Florence
LINE: Hmph. Rule seventeen: turf war or not, disqualified racers still share. ...Pass the cheese.
